title: GD-ST length and P-S connector spacing correlation for ILT-L branch-valve layouts
reason: The reviewed low-strain ILT-L branch-valve concept used EDAS precedent and containment rules for GD-ST length and P-S connector spacing, not a verified correlation/covariance model. Sufficient data is missing to claim optimized sizing.
required_before_claim: Before claiming GD-ST length or P-S connector spacing is low-strain optimized, retrieve or generate correlation evidence covering the selected branch-valve layout family and response locations.
